# Asset

A non-property asset: financial accounts, personal property, vehicles, digital assets, business interests, Islamic finance instruments, etc

Source: [`v3/asset.json`](../../v3/asset.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/asset.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this asset within the INHERIT document |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Display name for this asset. Should be specific enough to identify the item during probate |
| `category` | one of `financial`, `vehicle`, `digital`, `business`, `property_contents`, `jewellery_watches`, `art`, `antiques`, `collectibles`, `musical_instruments`, `books_manuscripts`, `wine_spirits`, `clothing_textiles`, `firearms_sporting`, `islamic_financial`, `other` | yes | Top-level category from the INHERIT Product Taxonomy. Use the `subcategory` field for finer classification. See `reference-data/category-guidance.json` for valid subcategories, recommended identifiers, and photography guidance per category |
| `subcategory` | `string` | | Finer classification within the top-level category. Values are defined in reference-data/category-guidance.json but the field is freeform to accommodate jurisdiction-specific asset types. Examples: financial → 'pension', collectibles → 'model_railways', vehicle → 'classic_vehicle' |
| `estimatedValue` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Owner's estimate of the asset's current value, in minor currency units |
| `professionalValuation` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Professional valuation of the asset, in minor currency units |
| `netEquity` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Value of this asset net of the active charges secured against it, in minor currency units. A convenience denormalisation: the authoritative figure is derived, not stored |
| `inNegativeEquity` | `boolean` | | True when the active charges secured against this asset exceed its value. Set alongside a netEquity of zero, because the zero floor would otherwise hide the shortfall |
| `valuationDate` | `string` (date) | | Date of the most recent valuation |
| `valuationConfidence` | one of `estimated`, `professional`, `official`, `unknown` | | Level of confidence in the stated valuation |
| `condition` | one of `excellent`, `good`, `fair`, `poor`, `unknown`, `not_applicable` | | Physical condition of the asset. Affects resale value — dealers use this to price items. Pair with conditionSystem and conditionGrade for domain-specific grading. Use 'not_applicable' for financial assets where condition is meaningless |
| `quantity` | `integer` | | Number of items if this represents multiple identical or similar items |
| `location` | `string` | | Where this asset is physically stored or held — a bank, safe, property, or institution |
| `propertyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Property.id if this asset is located at a specific property in the estate |
| `assetCollectionId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the AssetCollection.id this asset belongs to. An asset may belong to at most one collection. If set, this asset's value contributes to the collection's total |
| `spaceId` | `string` or `null` (uuid) | | Reference to a Space.id representing where this item is physically stored. Critical for collections spread across multiple properties or countries — affects probate jurisdiction and dealer collection logistics |
| `identifiers` | array of [Identifier](common/identifier.md) | | External identifiers — serial numbers, account numbers, policy references, registration numbers, etc |
| `externalLinks` | array of `object` | | Links to this asset in external databases, marketplaces, and registries. The universal connector — any external system can be referenced without a schema change. Use identifiers for formal identifier schemes (ISBN, VIN, NINO); use externalLinks for platform-specific references, product pages, and database entries |
| `productPage` | `string` (uri) | | URI pointing to the manufacturer's or retailer's official product page for this exact item. Distinct from storageRef (document storage) and externalLinks (database references). Enables direct linking to manufacturer specifications, manuals, and warranty information |
| `provenanceChain` | array of `object` | | Prior ownership records — establishes the chain of provenance for the asset. Critical for art, antiques, and high-value collectibles |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Photographs, videos, and document scans. Vision-capable AI agents use these to identify items, assess condition, and find visual matches on marketplaces. Use viewType from media.json to categorize each media item |
| `possessionStatus` | one of `possessed_at_death`, `receivable`, `contingent` | | Whether the asset was held at death, is receivable post-death, or is contingent on a future event |
| `mobilityType` | one of `immoveable`, `moveable`, `mixed` | | Whether this asset is classified as immoveable or moveable property. Affects which conflict-of-laws rules apply in cross-border estates |
| `acquisitionType` | one of `self_acquired`, `ancestral_joint`, `ancestral_severed`, `inherited`, `gifted`, `stridhan`, `communal`, `waqf_endowed` | | How this asset was acquired. Determines succession rules in Indian and other customary systems |
| `registrationStatus` | one of `formally_registered`, `informally_held`, `community_acknowledged`, `disputed`, `undocumented` | | Whether ownership of this asset is formally registered or documented |
| `ownershipEvidence` | one of `title_deed`, `certificate_of_occupancy`, `family_recognition`, `community_testimony`, `receipts_only`, `none` | | The type of evidence available to prove ownership of this asset |
| `culturalDisposition` | [Cultural Disposition](common/cultural-disposition.md) | | Cultural, religious, and regulatory constraints on disposal of this asset |
| `communalAuthority` | `object` | | The communal or family authority whose approval is required to dispose of this asset |
| `successionRegime` | `object` | | The succession regime governing this specific asset. Overrides estate.defaultSuccessionRegime when present |
| `beneficiaryDesignation` | `object` | | Named beneficiary designation for this asset. Assets with beneficiary designations pass outside the probate estate — the will does not control their distribution |
| `digitalAccessConsent` | `object` | | Digital access consent under RUFADAA or equivalent legislation. Governs whether executors and fiduciaries can access the deceased's digital accounts and assets |
| `passesOutsideEstate` | `boolean` | | Whether this asset passes outside the probate estate. Beneficiary designations, POD accounts, and jointly held assets typically bypass the will |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this asset. Use for provenance, sentimental value, special handling instructions, or anything not captured by structured fields |
| `description` | `string` | | Structured description of the asset — what it is, its significance, and key details a dealer or executor would need. Distinct from 'notes' which is free-form |
| `brand` | `string` or `object` | | The manufacturer or brand name. Accepts a plain string (backwards compatible) or a structured object with Wikidata linkage for rich product data. AI agents should use this as a primary search dimension when finding comparables |
| `model` | `string` | | The specific model, product line, or range name. Combined with brand and identifiers, this is the primary key for marketplace search. AI agents construct search queries from brand + model + subcategory |
| `purchaseDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the asset was acquired by the current owner. Used for capital gains tax calculations, insurance claims, and provenance. Maps to Schema.org purchaseDate |
| `originalPackaging` | one of `complete`, `partial`, `box_only`, `papers_only`, `none`, `unknown` | | Whether original packaging, documentation, and accessories are present. Affects value by 20–40% across watches, model railways, jewellery, and many other domains |
| `custodian` | `object` | | Third party currently holding this asset — a bank (safe deposit), storage facility (bonded wine), repairer (watch at jeweller), gallery (art on loan), or institution. The executor needs to know who to contact |
| `conditionSystem` | one of `goldmine`, `sheldon`, `ags`, `bsc`, `gia`, `watch_trade`, `classic_vehicle`, `book_trade` or `string` | | The grading system used for the conditionGrade value. Allows domain-specific condition assessment alongside the generic condition field |
| `conditionGrade` | `string` | | The specific grade within the conditionSystem. Meaningful only when conditionSystem is set |
| `conditionStandard` | `string` (uri) | | URI pointing to the official documentation of the grading standard used. Enables tools to display the correct grading scale and interpret the conditionGrade value |
| `urgency` | one of `immediate`, `within_7_days`, `within_30_days`, `none` | | How urgently this asset needs attention after the testator's death. Drives the executor's priority list |
| `urgencyReason` | `string` | | Explanation of why this asset is urgent. Particularly important for 'immediate' items |
| `containedInAssetId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to another Asset.id if this asset is physically contained within or logically part of another asset. Enables hierarchical asset nesting — e.g. a watch inside a safe, tools inside a toolbox |
| `insurance` | `object` | | Insurance coverage for this asset. The executor needs to know what's insured, by whom, and whether cover continues after death |
| `purchasedFrom` | `string` | | Where the asset was purchased or acquired from. Collectors track provenance — valuable for dealers and for establishing authenticity |
| `splitFrom` | `object` | | Provenance record when this entity was created by splitting a larger entity. The original entity is typically archived after the split |
| `dataProvenance` | one of `manual_entry`, `ai_extracted`, `ocr_scanned`, `imported`, `migrated`, `system_generated` | | How this specific entity's data was captured. Overrides the document-level default if set |
| `searchTerms` | array of `string` | | Keywords for marketplace search — AI-generated or human-curated. Memoization: once derived, cached here so subsequent agents reuse them instantly rather than re-deriving |
| `comparableSearchProfile` | `object` | | Structured search instructions for comparable-finding agents. Acts as agent memory — the item teaches future agents how to find its peers |
| `suggestedSubcategory` | `string` | | AI-suggested subcategory refinement, kept separate from the human-set subcategory. Accepted when the user confirms. Provenance: always AI-generated |
| `valuationReliability` | `integer` | | Numeric reliability score (0-100) for the current valuation. Computed from: recency, method, corroborating comparables, variance between estimates. Companion to the categorical valuationConfidence enum — the enum captures source, this number captures trustworthiness now. Agents use this to prioritise which assets need re-valuation |
| `lastVerifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this entity's data was last verified by a human or authoritative source. Agents use this to decide whether to trust existing values or re-derive them |
| `verifiedBy` | `string` | | Who or what verified this entity — a person's name, a tool, or 'owner' |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | Controls who can see this asset. Some assets (firearms, digital accounts, sensitive collections) may need restricted visibility |
| `fieldProvenance` | array of [FieldProvenance](common/field-provenance.md) | | Per-field provenance records — how each field's value was obtained |
| `comments` | array of `object` | | Discussion comments on this entity |
| `mergedInto` | `object` | | Records that this entity was merged into another entity — the target entity is the canonical version |
| `spaceIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced storage location |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `applicableLaw` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction whose succession law governs this item. Missing means defaults to estate domicile |
| `taxTreatment` | `object` | | Per-asset tax treatment — how this asset is classified for tax purposes in a specific jurisdiction |
| `accessInstructions` | `object` | | Instructions for accessing this asset after death — steps, locations, holders. No secrets in the document, just instructions for finding them. Available for all asset categories (digital: crypto wallets, social media; physical: safes, storage units) |
| `ownerIntent` | one of `keeping`, `considering`, `thinning`, `listed`, `sold`, `allocated`, `donated` | | The owner's current intention for this item. Absent means keeping (the default). Used by catalogue applications to track whether items are being actively managed, offered for sale, or allocated to specific people |
| `listings` | array of `object` | | Active or historical listings of this item for sale on external channels. Tracks where the item is listed, its status, and sale outcome. Application-level data — not part of the estate interchange but carried alongside it for catalogue and dealer workflows |
| `serviceHistory` | array of [ServiceRecord](#def-ServiceRecord) | | Service, maintenance, and restoration records. Critical for watches (service intervals affect value), vehicles (MOT history, restoration), clocks, and musical instruments |
| `insuranceCover` | `object` | | Insurance details for this item. Tracks which policy covers it, the agreed value, and when cover was last confirmed. Essential for executors who need to claim on the correct policy |
| `shippingClass` | one of `parcel`, `large_item`, `specialist_transport`, `collection_only` | | How this item can be transported for selling or verification. Determines which logistics path the Deal Comparison uses |
| `includedDocuments` | array of one of `outer_box`, `inner_box`, `warranty_card`, `cosc_certificate`, `instruction_manual`, `hang_tags`, `service_booklet`, `purchase_receipt`, `original_invoice`, `v5c_logbook`, `mot_certificate`, `provenance_letter`, `certificate_of_authenticity`, `appraisal_certificate`, `export_licence`, `customs_declaration` or `string` | | Original documents, certificates, and packaging elements present with this item. Affects value significantly across many categories. Cross-category: watches, vehicles, books, art, and collectibles share some document types |
| `taxReliefEligibility` | `object` | | Tax relief eligibility for this asset or property (e.g. Agricultural Property Relief, Business Property Relief) |
| `significance` | `object` | | Cultural, religious, sentimental, or professional significance beyond monetary value |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-ServiceRecord"></a>

### ServiceRecord

A single service, maintenance, or restoration record for a mechanical or valuable item. Used for watches, vehicles, clocks, musical instruments, and any item with a service lifecycle

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `serviceDate` | `string` (date) | yes | When the service was performed |
| `provider` | `string` | | Who performed the service (manufacturer service centre, independent specialist, etc.) |
| `description` | `string` | | What was done |
| `cost` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Cost of the service, in minor currency units |
| `documentReference` | `string` | | Reference to a service certificate, receipt, or MOT certificate |
